intro: Tenaron Stormgrip is a night elf guide high within Aldrassil, the central tree of Shadowglen. He teaches young kaldorei the recent history of their people while asking them to gather moonwell water.

p: Perched upon the winding wooden platforms of Aldrassil, Tenaron Stormgrip stands as an early mentor to young night elves stepping forth from the boughs of Shadowglen. From his vantage point, he monitors the health of the local woods and the vital moonwells that sustain them. His role is to instruct novices in understanding their profound spiritual connection to the World Tree.

Tenaron begins the journey known as Crown of the Earth. He sends initiates to gather a phial of water from the moonwell north of Aldrassil, teaching them what followed the Battle of Mount Hyjal. The journey continues through Teldrassil and into Darnassus.
